fusions.name: Unseen Opening
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 32 damage, always crits and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Palmed Blade
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to this blow, and deals 8 damage. It has 50% more critical chance until something has bled. You hold 3 charges and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hidden Riposte
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 40% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Finding the Seam
fusions.desc: Your slashing damage cannot be resisted and ignores 15% of the target's armour. Your abilities come round 5% sooner.
